decision_summary: Self-review approves v0.6.33 implementation subject to its explicit policy-local and evidence-only boundaries.
rationale: Visionary: the records answer why a specific forecast error matters at a named loss boundary. Builder: source intent, gate decision, outcome review, threshold action, class, weight, aggregate arithmetic, and trigger references are executable. Guardian: high/critical policies require false-assurance priority; severe false assurance, policy review gaps, insufficient data, and tolerance breaches route to governance. The forecast remains gate-level, so the verifier additionally requires both the source gate decision and outcome review to identify the policy Quality Intent. Weights remain local priorities and cannot be interpreted across policies.
recommendation: Proceed to final verification and release; carry threshold sensitivity and brittleness into v0.6.34.
